units.text: INT. HAYDEN PLANETARIUM DOME - NIGHT (BLACKOUT)
The star projector is dead.
Only a handful of emergency lights glow along the wall.
The dome ceiling is a flat gray void.
INSPECTOR AGNES TRELAWNEY, fifties, in a belted raincoat, stands at the center aisle with a torch.
PROFESSOR BALTHAZAR OYELARAN, seventies, in a velvet jacket, sits in the front row.
CORMAC, a lanky security guard, hovers by the exit.
ASTRID VOLKOVA, thirties, the curator, wrings her hands beside the projector console.
Who last saw Doctor Pell alive?
units.name: AGNES

units.text: I did, at nine. He went to calibrate the
units.name: ASTRID

units.text: He was fussing with the Zeiss, as usual.
units.name: BALTHAZAR

units.text: I locked the east door at ten. Nobody came in.
units.name: CORMAC

units.text: Nobody went out?
units.name: AGNES

units.text: Nobody.
units.name: CORMAC

units.text: Her radio crackles.
Inspector, Sergeant Pui-Ling. We have the body in the sub-basement. Cause of death looks like electrical.
units.name: PUI-LING

units.text: Understood. Keep the scene sealed.
units.name: AGNES

units.text: Electrical? In a planetarium. How apt.
units.name: BALTHAZAR

units.text: Professor, please.
units.name: ASTRID

units.text: Please what? A man is dead, and the stars are out. It's a metaphor, my dear.
units.name: BALTHAZAR

units.text: Sir, it's a crime scene.
units.name: CORMAC

units.text: Quiet, all of you.
units.name: AGNES

units.text: A door clatters open at the far end of the dome.
JAMAL REYES, twenties, in a janitor's coverall, stumbles in with a bucket, blinking at the torchlight.
He sees four faces turned toward him and freezes.
Sorry. Nobody told me there was a meeting.
units.name: JAMAL

units.text: Jamal, where have you been?
units.name: ASTRID

units.text: Mopping the lobby. The power went out, I thought
units.name: JAMAL

units.text: Mr. Reyes. Put down the bucket.
units.name: AGNES

units.text: He does.
A little water slops onto the floor and spreads across the tiles, catching the emergency light in a thin, bright line.
Inspector, there's a mop in the sub-basement. Wet.
units.name: PUI-LING

units.text: Agnes looks at Jamal.
Jamal looks at the bucket.
Cormac steps in front of the exit.
